candidates.change_summary: Replaced withdrawAll implementation to send only half the contract balance, changing post-call observed balance.
Replaced withdrawAll to call withdraw with zero value, leaving contract balance unchanged.
Modified onlyOwner to invert the check (require caller is NOT owner), changing which callers can execute withdrawAll and thus its observed effect.
Modified onlyOwner to be permissive (no check), allowing anyone to call withdrawAll and change observed post-call balance.
Changed transfer target from msg.sender to owner so withdraw always sends funds to the stored owner address instead of the caller.
Removed the require check so onlyOwner modifier no longer restricts access, allowing anyone to call withdraw and thus possibly change observed withdraw behavior.
Replaced transfer with a low-level call to forward funds, changing failure behavior and gas semantics of withdraw.
Replace the low-level call with a call that forwards zero value (overwrites _value to 0) so sendMoney does not transfer ETH and thus leaves balances unchanged.
Replace the low-level call with a call that always succeeds (ignores returned success) and does not revert on failure, changing whether sendMoney reverts and thus observable state after the call.
Change onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove the require), so sendMoney becomes callable by non-owners and can change state when called by others.
